set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit [parameter2] family inet address [p.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set system services ssh root-login [para.explanation: Configure SSH services, prohibiting root users from login.

parameters.name: root-login
parameters.explanation: Whether or not to control root users can log in through SSH and Deny says no.

set system services ssh protocol-version.explanation: Configure the protocol version used for SSH services.

parameters.name: protocol-version
parameters.explanation: SSH protocol version, v2 indicates use of SSH version 2.

class [parameter2] authentication [param.explanation: Configure system login users, set user categories and authentication methods.

full-name [full_name].explanation: Configure a user's full name in the system login settings

parameters.name: full name
parameters.explanation: The full name to be associated with the username

parameters.name: connection-limit
